meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 它会组建一个 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎人 + 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,对候选漏洞写出复现步骤、验证是否真能被利用,按可利用性定级,最后交出带结论(通过/通过但有发现/阻止)与修复建议的报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“security review”“vulnerability audit”等关键词、使用 /security-research 命令,或要做发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证时触发。需先启用 team_mode 并在主会话中运行。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前分支的改动
say.note: 先收集 diff,再分队并行审计

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次可利用性审计,别跑破坏性测试
say.note: 会记录约束,优先用本地静态验证

say.text: 验证这个漏洞候选到底能不能被利用
say.note: 两名 PoC 工程师会独立复现或证伪

howto.what_en: It spins up a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, build PoCs to prove or disprove exploitability, rate severity by real exploitability, and return a verdict (PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK) plus fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', etc., the /security-research command, or a pre-release security check or threat model validation. Needs team mode enabled and the main session.

say_en.text: Use security-research to audit the current branch diff
say_en.note: Collects the diff, then runs the hunter team

say_en.text: Run an exploitability audit on this repo, no destructive tests
say_en.note: Records the constraint and prefers static proof

say_en.text: Verify whether this vulnerability candidate is actually exploitable
say_en.note: Two PoC engineers reproduce or falsify it
